Algeria summoned the UAE ambassador and gave him 48 hours to comply, saying it had exhausted means of preserving bilateral relations. UAE commercial flights to Algiers remain exempt until the end of 2026. Abu Dhabi said it hoped the decision would be temporary and remained committed to ties between the peoples. The rupture highlights divisions over Western Sahara, I*ra/e.l and the Sahel.
